data.headline: For the one who stayed
data.subheadline: A small website made from the moments that kept returning.

photos.title: The Summer We Kept
photos.summary: A quiet afternoon folded into light, color, and the small details that stayed.
photos.detail: 那天其实没有发生什么惊天动地的事情，但正因为这样，它才像一张真正属于我们的照片。光线、空气、走过的路，还有你说话时很轻的语气，都被留在这里。

photos.title: Blue Hour Promise
photos.summary: A frame for the promise to meet again when the sky turns blue.
photos.detail: 有些回忆不需要被解释得太完整，只要一个颜色、一个地点、一个当时没有说出口的念头，就足够把人带回去。

photos.title: After the Rain
photos.summary: The kind of stillness that arrives after laughter, weather, and long walks.
photos.detail: 雨停以后，很多东西都变得安静。我们好像也没有刻意记住什么，但后来想起来，偏偏是这种安静最清楚。

photos.title: Quiet Frame
photos.summary: A small cinematic pause before the evening changed color.
photos.detail: 这张照片像一小段暂停。它没有催促任何事情发生，只是把那个瞬间放慢，留给以后慢慢看。

photos.title: Last Light
photos.summary: The final glow before the day turned into something softer.
photos.detail: 最后一点光落下来的时候，很多普通的东西都会突然变得郑重。也许礼物最重要的部分，就是把这种郑重留下来。

data.headline: Keep this close
data.message: Some memories do not end. They keep finding their way back into view.
